findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "SSL 憑證自動化平台" (pill) above "憑證自動化，但私鑰放哪裡由你決定"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 30 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.page-hero-content.glass-panel → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.37) 0px 8px 32px 0px | a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.3) 0px 4px 15px 0px | div.prose.glass-panel → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.37) 0px 8px 32px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
3 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): p.price-note 894px | footer 1440px | div.footer-bottom 1136px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 98 characters per line.
The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 44px (3.1vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The margins differ: 152px on the left, 188px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("憑證自動化，但私鑰放哪裡由你決定") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: 33% of the first screen is one empty block (540×780px at 900,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "憑證自動化，但私鑰放哪裡由你決定" → 3 lines (1 words, 33.6px); "三種私鑰模式，由你決定金鑰放在哪裡" → 3 lines (1 words, 40px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): a.btn.btn-primary → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(0, 242, 254) 0%, rgb(79, 172, 254) 100%) | a.btn.btn-primary → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(0, 242, 254) 0%, rgb(79, 172, 254) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
